system_requirements.Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Equivalent
system_requirements.Additional Notes: Local CO-OP mode is more demanding and may need more powerful hardware than the minimum requirements. Local CO-OP also requires 2 controllers. A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online. Havoc modes (3/4 player) are additional modes and will require more powerful hardware than the minimum.
